headline: Gazipur farmers smash eggs in protest over falling prices
summary: Marginal poultry farmers in Sreepur demand fair prices as production costs soar while market rates plummet.
details: Marginal poultry farmers in Sreepur upazila of Gazipur staged a human chain and smashed eggs on the Dhaka-Mymensingh Highway to demand fair prices for their produce.
The protest, organized by Messrs Hannan Enterprise, saw farmers carrying placards questioning why they are trapped in debt despite providing essential nutrition.
Protesters claim they are suffering heavy losses because the current market price of eggs has fallen below the cost of production.
According to farmer Hasibul Hasan Islam, an egg currently sells for about Tk 6.50, while the cost to produce one ranges between Tk 8.50 and Tk 9.
The farmers highlighted that the costs of poultry feed, medicines, and farm maintenance have increased significantly, making it impossible to sustain small-scale farms.
When contacted, Sreepur Upazila Nirbahi Officer Md Nahid Bhuiyan stated that no marginal farmers had approached him yet, but he expressed readiness to listen to their concerns.
caption:
An egg costs Tk 9 to produce but sells for only Tk 6.50. Gazipur farmers are smashing eggs in protest.

Marginal poultry farmers in Sreepur upazila of Gazipur staged a human chain and smashed eggs on the Dhaka-Mymensingh Highway to demand fair prices for their produce.

The protest, organized by Messrs Hannan Enterprise, saw farmers carrying placards questioning why they are trapped in debt despite providing essential nutrition.

Protesters claim they are suffering heavy losses because the current market price of eggs has fallen below the cost of production.

According to farmer Hasibul Hasan Islam, an egg currently sells for about Tk 6.50, while the cost to produce one ranges between Tk 8.50 and Tk 9.

The farmers highlighted that the costs of poultry feed, medicines, and farm maintenance have increased significantly, making it impossible to sustain small-scale farms.

When contacted, Sreepur Upazila Nirbahi Officer Md Nahid Bhuiyan stated that no marginal farmers had approached him yet, but he expressed readiness to listen to their concerns.

headline: Job Alert: One Bank hiring without experience, Sajeeb Group recruiting
summary: Fresh graduates and job seekers can apply for positions at One Bank and Sajeeb Group as they open recruitment drives.
details: One Bank has announced that it is accepting applications for new positions, notably opening opportunities for candidates without prior professional experience.
This move provides a significant opportunity for fresh graduates to enter the banking sector and start their careers.
Simultaneously, Sajeeb Group has also announced that it is looking to recruit new manpower to expand its workforce.
Interested candidates are encouraged to check the official recruitment portals of both organizations for application details and requirements.
